items.item_text: Most current Minimum Qualifications for Faculty in California Community Colleges: Master's degree in Kinesiology, physical education, exercise science, education with an emphasis in physical education, Kinesiology, physiology of exercise or adaptive physical education
Instruct students in the assigned discipline.

Travel between District locations is also expected
